notes.title: New BUILD!
notes.content:
Here’s a quick summary of what’s new:

[list]
[*] New control: the game now only uses 1 mouse button. All the keyboard shortcuts remain available and unchanged

[*] New ‘’End of Day’’ mechanic: this moment is now better telegraphed and the option to end the day early is now possible

[*] New world map: The level selection screen has been redrawn! 

[*] UI tweaks: Some buttons has been modified for increased visibility

[*] Tutorials tweaks: new players should now have a better onboarding experience

[*] Various bug fixes: everyone should now have a smoother experience

[*] Backend tweaks: Some files that were previously embedded in the .EXE are now stored separately. This should prevent some users from receiving a false positive from their anti-virus software. Please note that some AV software can still falsely flag the game as a virus. It is not. This change should at least prevent some false flags when manually scanning the .EXE with an AV software or a website like VirusTotal.
[/list]

I am aware of the seriousness of that last problem and I am aware that this problem is preventing some users from experiencing Idler Coaster. Sadly, there’s no quick and easy fix I can do. To fully fix the problem and to prevent it from reappearing in the future, the game needs to be redone from scratch using another game engine. This is why the delays between updates are huge as Idler Coaster is a solo project made by a hobbyist.

I’d like to thank everyone for their patience regarding that matter and I’d like to reiterate my commitment to deliver a quality product that everyone can enjoy.

Cheers!

notes.title: New Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who playtested Idler Coaster, this new build features YOURS feedback!

[list]
[*] Build mode? Gone
[*] Controls? Modified
[*] Other stuff? Improved!
[/list]

You can now always interact with the environment for a smoother experience. The controls and the tutorials have been modified accordingly. A multitude of small improvements have been also added to enhance your experience.

Builders, get ready to turn those cotton candies and those innocent smiles [b]INTO PURE PROFITS![/b]
